title: 🗺️ The New Delivery Route — GTLA 1
ps_sub: The New Delivery Route · B1–B2 · self-marking
foot: 🗺️ GTLA 1 · The New Delivery Route — B1–B2 · self-marking 🗺️
story: Nadia is a logistics manager in Dijon. Every day, her drivers deliver goods to twenty shops in the region. The current route is not optimized: the trucks drive too many kilometers, they often come back empty, and two drivers sometimes visit the same area. Nadia knows the company loses time and fuel.

Last week, Nadia analyzed the delivery data. She mapped every stop, measured the distances and tested a new route on the computer. She also called the drivers and asked for their opinion. The new plan grouped the shops by zone and removed the empty return trips.

Since Monday, the new route has reduced the distance by twenty percent and has saved fuel. But one important client, a supermarket, hasn't accepted the new delivery time yet. Nadia has called the manager to negotiate: she wants to keep the client happy without breaking the whole schedule. 🚚

sections.name: TN Tenses
sections.heading: Conjugation — present, past or present perfect?
sections.instr: Choisis le bon temps : présent simple (habitude), prétérit (fini, daté) ou present perfect (bilan, depuis).

items.text: Nadia ___ a logistics team every day.
Last week, she ___ the delivery data.
Since Monday, the new route ___ the distance.
The drivers ___ back empty yesterday.
The company ___ a lot of fuel so far.
A good driver ___ the schedule every morning.
She ___ a new route on the computer last Tuesday.
The client ___ the new time yet.

sections.name: TR Traduction
sections.heading: Traduis : quel temps choisir ?
sections.instr: Lis la phrase française et choisis la bonne traduction. Le repère de temps t'indique le temps à utiliser.

items.text: « Chaque jour, les camions livrent les marchandises. »
options: Every day, the trucks deliver the goods.
Every day, the trucks delivered the goods.
items.answer: Every day, the trucks deliver the goods.

items.text: « La semaine dernière, Nadia a analysé les données. »
options: Last week, Nadia analyzed the data.
Last week, Nadia has analyzed the data.
items.answer: Last week, Nadia analyzed the data.

items.text: « Depuis lundi, la nouvelle route a réduit la distance. »
options: Since Monday, the new route has reduced the distance.
Since Monday, the new route reduced the distance.
items.answer: Since Monday, the new route has reduced the distance.

items.text: « Hier, les chauffeurs sont revenus à vide. »
options: Yesterday, the drivers came back empty.
Yesterday, the drivers have come back empty.
items.answer: Yesterday, the drivers came back empty.

items.text: « Elle n'a pas encore optimisé toute la tournée. »
options: She hasn't optimized the whole route yet.
She didn't optimize the whole route yet.
items.answer: She hasn't optimized the whole route yet.

items.text: « L'an dernier, l'entreprise a acheté trois camions. »
options: Last year, the company bought three trucks.
Last year, the company has bought three trucks.
items.answer: Last year, the company bought three trucks.

items.text: « Nous livrons ce client depuis 2021. »
options: We have delivered to this client since 2021.
We delivered to this client since 2021.
items.answer: We have delivered to this client since 2021.

items.text: « Mardi dernier, elle a testé la nouvelle route. »
options: Last Tuesday, she tested the new route.
Last Tuesday, she has tested the new route.
items.answer: Last Tuesday, she tested the new route.

sections.name: RS Reported
sections.heading: Reported speech — what did they say?
sections.instr: Passe du discours direct au discours rapporté (backshift des temps, modaux, pronoms).

items.text: “I will optimize the route,” Nadia said. → Nadia said she ___ the route.
“We have saved fuel,” she said. → She said they ___ fuel.
“The trucks are coming back empty,” he said. → He said the trucks ___ back empty.
“I can change the schedule,” she said. → She said she ___ change the schedule.
“Do you deliver on Saturdays?” the client asked. → The client asked if we ___ on Saturdays.
“Call the driver,” she said. → She told me ___ the driver.
“We changed the route yesterday,” Nadia said. → Nadia said they ___ the route the day before.
“The delivery isn't late,” he said. → He said the delivery ___ late.

sections.name: NG Negotiation
sections.heading: Choose the right expression
sections.instr: Lis le but entre parenthèses, puis choisis l'expression la plus adaptée. Les trois sont du bon anglais, mais une seule convient à la situation.

items.text: (You want to open the call politely.)
options: Thank you for taking my call. Do you have a few minutes?
We need to talk, and it's urgent.
I know you're busy, but this is more important.
items.answer: Thank you for taking my call. Do you have a few minutes?

items.text: (The client is angry about the new time. You want to stay calm and listen.)
options: I understand this is frustrating. Can you tell me what works best for you?
Rules are rules, there's nothing I can do.
items.answer: I understand this is frustrating. Can you tell me what works best for you?

items.text: (The client asks for free delivery you cannot offer. Refuse politely.)
options: I'm sorry, I can't remove the fee, but I can offer an earlier slot.
items.answer: I'm sorry, I can't remove the fee, but I can offer an earlier slot.

items.text: (You want to propose a compromise on the time.)
options: Could we agree on 8 a.m. instead of 7?
You'll take the time I give you.
Fine, choose any time you like.
items.answer: Could we agree on 8 a.m. instead of 7?

items.text: (The client is unsure about the change. Reassure them.)
options: Don't worry — the same driver will handle your store.
If it doesn't work, that's on you.
To be honest, it might cause delays.
items.answer: Don't worry — the same driver will handle your store.

items.text: (You need to check with your team before deciding.)
options: Let me confirm with my drivers and call you back today.
I'll promise anything to keep you happy.
Just trust me, no need to check.
items.answer: Let me confirm with my drivers and call you back today.

items.text: (You want to know the client's main priority.)
options: What matters most to you — the time or the price?
Honestly, your requests don't help me.
Let's not waste time on details.
items.answer: What matters most to you — the time or the price?

items.text: (You want to close the deal on good terms.)
options: Perfect — I'll send you the new schedule in writing.
You'd better stick to this now.
I suppose that will have to do.
items.answer: Perfect — I'll send you the new schedule in writing.
